Jakie dane i w jakim celu: What data is processed and why
Przetwarzane mogą być dane podane w wiad: We may process data provided in an email, telephone conversation or contact form, including your name, company, email address, telephone number and information about your enquiry.
Dane są wykorzystywane do obsługi zapyta: The information is used to handle enquiries, correspond with you, arrange conversations, prepare for or deliver an engagement, comply with legal obligations, and establish, pursue or defend potential claims.
Za pośrednictwem formularza kontaktowego: The contact form accepts an email address (required) and, optionally, a phone number, company name and description of your enquiry. All information other than the email address is voluntary. We do not ask for your location, precise postal address or special-category personal data.
Dane z formularza będą wykorzystywane wy: Contact-form data is used solely to receive and respond to your request, maintain correspondence and, where relevant, take steps prior to entering into a contract. It is not used to send unsolicited marketing communications.
W zależności od okoliczności podstawą pr: Depending on the circumstances, processing is based on Article 6(1)(b) GDPR (steps taken at the data subject's request prior to entering into a contract) or Article 6(1)(f) GDPR (legitimate interests in handling enquiries and correspondence, for example where the enquiry is made by a representative of an organisation). Separate consent is not required merely to respond to a request for contact.
Zgłoszenia z formularza są przekazywane: Contact-form submissions are delivered to Microsoft 365 email through Microsoft Graph and Microsoft Azure hosting. Cloudflare Turnstile is used for anti-bot verification before submission. Rate limiting uses counters in Azure Table Storage; email addresses, IP addresses and message contents are not stored in that table. These service providers may process technical data necessary to operate and protect the form. Some processing may involve transfers outside the European Economic Area, subject to appropriate legal safeguards.
Sam formularz nie służy do zbierania dok: The form itself does not collect precise GPS location, IP-based geolocation or the device's time zone. Hosting and security providers may process standard connection-related technical data, with scope and retention determined by those services' settings.
W przypadku zapytań, które nie doprowadz: For enquiries that do not lead to an engagement, contact-form correspondence is retained for up to 12 months after the matter is closed and then removed from the active mailbox, unless a specific legal obligation or a justified need to establish, pursue or defend claims requires otherwise. If the enquiry results in a contract, retention periods may be governed by rules on contractual or accounting records. The retention of technical data by hosting and security providers depends on their configuration and applicable service policies.
Podstawą przetwarzania jest podjęcie dzi: Legal bases for processing include taking steps at a person's request prior to entering into a contract or performing a contract, meeting the controller's legal obligations, and legitimate interests in correspondence, handling enquiries and protection against claims.
Dane są przechowywane przez czas potrzeb: Data is retained for as long as needed to handle the matter and perform any engagement, and subsequently for periods required by law or appropriate for protecting against claims.
Dane mogą być powierzane dostawcom usług: Data may be entrusted to providers of services necessary for business operations, particularly hosting, email, Microsoft 365, analytics and technical support, solely to the extent necessary to deliver those services.
W zakresie przewidzianym prawem przysług: Subject to applicable law, you have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, restrict processing, data portability, object to processing and lodge a complaint with the President of the Polish Personal Data Protection Office (UODO).
W związku z prowadzoną korespondencją i: In connection with correspondence and engagements, we may process, in particular: name, job title, represented organisation, email address, telephone number, correspondence contents, information contained in documents provided and other information supplied voluntarily in connection with the matter.
Niektórzy dostawcy usług informatycznych: Some IT service providers may process personal data outside the European Economic Area. Such transfers are carried out using mechanisms permitted under data protection law and with the required safeguards.
